title: New Song Spotlight
song: If You Don't Know Me By Now
description: This week’s spotlight is Simply Red’s “If You Don’t Know Me By Now” — a soulful slow-burn ballad with room for Djembe to lean into tenderness, ache, and velvet-smooth phrasing. It brings a familiar romantic R&B moment into the set: intimate enough for Golden Hour, recognizable enough to pull the room close, and dramatic without overpowering the show’s warm glow. In honor of Dolly Parton’s passing, Djembe is also adding “Jolene” to the repertoire this week as a tribute to her storytelling, spirit, and unmistakable musical legacy.
songListNote: Simply Red’s soulful slow-burn ballad — an intimate romantic feature joining the show rotation. Tribute addition: “Jolene” by Dolly Parton is also joining the catalog this week in her honor.
